reasons.pad-worn: Pads or brake blocks worn (less than 1 mm of lining left).
reasons.pad-contaminated: Pads contaminated or oily: the brake squeals or loses power.
reasons.rotor-worn: Rotor too thin or deeply grooved.
reasons.rotor-warped: Rotor bent: it rubs once per wheel turn.
reasons.caliper-rub: Caliper misaligned: the rotor rubs on a pad.
reasons.lever-spongy: Spongy lever, or one that reaches the bar: air or a leak in the system.
reasons.hose-leak: Fluid leaking from the hose, the lever or the caliper.
reasons.brake-cable-frayed: Brake cable frayed, rusty or sticky.
reasons.brake-not-centered: Rim brake off-centre: one block rubs or touches first.
reasons.rim-brake-track-worn: Rim braking surface worn: the wear indicator is gone or the surface is concave.
reasons.rim-contaminated: Rim braking surface greasy or dirty.
reasons.lever-reach-wrong: Lever too far from the fingers or badly angled.
reasons.chain-elongation: Chain stretched past its wear limit: it is wearing the cassette and chainrings.
reasons.chain-stiff-link: Stiff link that makes the chain skip.
reasons.cassette-worn: Cassette teeth worn into shark fins: the chain skips.
reasons.hanger-bent: Derailleur hanger bent: the derailleur is no longer parallel to the sprockets.
reasons.front-shifting-imprecise: Front shifting imprecise, or the chain drops between the chainrings.
reasons.shift-cable-frayed: Shift cable frayed, rusty, or housing damaged.
reasons.drivetrain-dirty: Drivetrain dirty: sprockets, chainrings and jockey wheels full of grime.
reasons.hub-gear-slipping: The gear hub slips or skips gears.
reasons.bottom-bracket-play: Play or creaking in the bottom bracket.
reasons.crank-loose: Crank arm moving on the spindle.
reasons.tire-worn: Tyre worn: wear indicators reached, squared-off tread or casing showing.
reasons.tire-damaged: Tyre cut, bulging or with a cracked sidewall.
reasons.tube-punctured: Inner tube punctured or losing air within a few days.
reasons.valve-damaged: Valve bent, leaking core or missing cap.
reasons.sealant-dry: Tubeless sealant dried out: it no longer seals small punctures.
reasons.wheel-out-of-true: Wheel out of true, sideways or up and down.
reasons.hub-play: Play in the hub: the wheel moves sideways.
reasons.axle-not-secure: Quick release or thru-axle not properly closed.
reasons.headset-play: Play in the headset: the fork knocks under braking.
reasons.grips-worn: Grips worn or turning on the bar.
reasons.frame-crack: Crack, dent or deformation on the frame or fork.
reasons.frame-dirty: Dirty frame hiding the state of the parts.
reasons.saddle-damaged: Saddle torn, bent rails or saddle moving.
reasons.dropper-malfunction: Dropper post not returning or sinking on its own.
reasons.pedal-bearing-play: Pedal with play or rough rotation.
reasons.pedal-damaged: Pedal bent, pins missing or worn retention.
reasons.cleat-worn: Cleats worn: the foot unclips or floats too much.
reasons.suspension-leak: Oil leaking at the fork or shock seal.
reasons.suspension-service-due: Suspension due for a service: noises, harshness or lost settings.
reasons.suspension-play: Play in the suspension bushings or pivots.
reasons.battery-damaged: Battery dropped, swollen, cracked or running hot.
reasons.battery-mount-loose: Battery not locked firmly in its mount.
reasons.motor-noise: Noise, knocking or irregular assistance from the motor.
reasons.e-system-error: Error code on the display or assistance cutting out.
reasons.light-not-working: Light not switching on or flickering.
reasons.accessory-loose: Mudguard, rack or kickstand loose or rubbing.
